title: Day 91: International Media Spotlight on CJNG World Cup Threat — 1,907 Bodies in Guadalajara Since 2018; US Forces Training Mexican Military; 18 Days to FIFA Opening; El Sapo at Large
detail: Day 91 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). INTERNATIONAL WORLD CUP / CJNG SECURITY SPOTLIGHT — WAVE OF MAJOR MEDIA COVERAGE (May 21–24, 2026): As the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening approaches (18 days), a wave of international security-focused reporting documents CJNG's threat to the tournament. KEY FINDINGS: (1) GUADALAJARA BODY COUNT — KVIA / Puente News Collaborative (May 21, 2026): Between 2018 and March 2026, authorities found 1,907 bodies in Guadalajara and surrounding cities. Since January 2025 alone, 58 graves with 226 sets of remains have been discovered in the metro area. CJNG has recruited more than 45,000 minors across Mexico in recent years. Guadalajara's Akron Stadium will host four World Cup matches — including Spain–Uruguay — in CJNG's historic operational heartland. (2) THE WEEK (May 24, 2026): 'How Mexico's cartel wars cast a shadow over the FIFA World Cup' — documents that CJNG 'operates in every Mexican state and over 40 countries,' runs a decentralized franchise model with 'unprecedented territorial control or political penetration,' and has survived 91 days of post-Mencho decapitation pressure with no organizational fracture. (3) U.S. SPECIAL FORCES TRAINING CONFIRMATION (KVIA, May 21): U.S. special forces have been training Mexican military teams specifically on repelling stadium attacks and drone bomb defense tactics — the most specific public confirmation of active U.S.-Mexican military training for World Cup security. This is the operational U.S. security contribution running in parallel with the Mullin-Sheinbaum diplomatic framework. (4) FIFA OFFICIAL POSITION: FIFA President Gianni Infantino stated he is 'very reassured' about Mexico hosting and expects the tournament to run smoothly. FIFA reviewed and maintained Guadalajara as a host venue following the February–April CJNG violence wave and the El Jardinero/El Chucky decapitation operations. (5) HUMAN RIGHTS WARNINGS: Amnesty International called on FIFA and World Cup hosts to take urgent protective action for fans, players, journalists, workers, and communities — characterizing the current context as an 'acute human rights crisis.' Human Rights Watch joined AI in warning that FIFA has not adequately addressed risks in host cities. (6) INTERNATIONAL CARTEL COVERAGE: Al Jazeera, Sky Sports, worldcuptrackers.com, and other international outlets have all published World Cup/CJNG security risk analyses, marking the transition into the final World Cup security sprint with CJNG at center frame. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 91 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as CJNG's military chief and Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority target. He remains the primary outstanding security risk for Plan Kukulkan's final 18-day phase — his capture or elimination before June 11 is Mexico's stated primary CJNG enforcement objective ahead of the World Cup. PLAN KUKULKAN — 18 DAYS: Eighteen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Mexico has deployed 100,000+ security personnel — including 20,000 military + 55,000 police/private security + 2,500 vehicles + 24 aircraft + anti-drone systems + bomb-detection units — across three host cities. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 matches) remains under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 15: Fifteen days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) with no confirmed successor plaza boss. Port continuing under SEMAR surveillance. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION — DAY 91: Ongoing — Mullin-Sheinbaum June meeting framework active; FGR criminal investigation lines (jurisdictional invasion + possible treason) continue in parallel. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 91: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Chipo (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large).
